beats.title: Agent Carter#5
beats.text: A girl in the Soviet school for assassins who shares hidden bread with young Dottie. In a sparring match Dottie breaks her neck on the instructor's nod.

beats.title: Agent Carter#5
beats.text: A girl at the school who fakes tears for Dugan, stabs him (his vest stops it), kills Junior Juniper and later Mike Li, wounds Happy Sam, and escapes through the vents.

widows.name: Dottie Underwood

beats.title: Agent Carter#5
beats.text: As a girl she kills her friend Anya in training; as an adult she searches Peggy's room.

beats.title: Agent Carter#8
beats.text: She fights Peggy, is kicked out a window and slips away.

beats.title: Agent Carter#15
beats.text: Freed by Peggy to spy on Whitney Frost, she is tortured, then breaks free and escapes.

widows.fate: Alive, at large (escapes in Agent Carter#15)

beats.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
beats.text: Flashbacks show her Red Room training and graduation under Madame B.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: She returns with Yelena to destroy the Red Room and frees Taskmaster.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: Freed by Oksana's antidote, she works with Natasha and frees the Widows with the antidote gas.

beats.title: Hawkeye#5
beats.text: In 2018 she frees Widows with Sonya and vanishes in the Snap at Ana's home.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: A former Widow and Red Room scientist who made the control serum, then helps bring the Red Room down.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: Dreykov's daughter, chip-controlled as Taskmaster, hunts Natasha and Yelena until the antidote frees her.

beats.title: Thunderbolts*
beats.text: Working for Valentina, she is killed by Ghost in the vault.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: An escaped Widow holding the antidote in Morocco. Yelena fatally stabs her, but Oksana sprays her with the antidote and asks her to free the others before dying.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: Yelena's partner in Morocco, who reports her desertion and calls in Taskmaster. In Budapest she chases Natasha and Yelena, falls and breaks her leg, and Dreykov makes her shoot herself.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: She fits Taskmaster's chip and sends her on a mission. Later she fights Natasha in the Red Room, is freed by Yelena's gas, and leaves with Yelena and Antonia.

widows.name: Helen
titles: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: Unnamed on screen here: a Widow who chokes Natasha with a staff in the Red Room until the gas frees her, then flies out with Yelena.

beats.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
beats.text: Named by Jon Jon ("Nice one, Helen!"), she fights an Extremis-powered man at Xialing's Golden Daggers Club in Macau. The film itself never calls her a Widow.

beats.title: Black Widow
beats.text: Freed by the gas, she asks Natasha in Finnish what they should do now, and Natasha tells them to get far away. She leaves with Yelena.

beats.title: Hawkeye#5
beats.text: In 2018 she and Yelena break into Ana's home and spray her with the antidote. She teases Yelena about her dream life with Natasha and survives the Snap.

beats.title: Hawkeye#5
beats.text: A former Widow who was never under Dreykov's control and now kills for money. After the Snap she quits, marries and adopts a daughter, and welcomes Yelena back five years later.

beats.title: Thunderbolts*
beats.text: A fellow Red Room trainee in Yelena's memories. Yelena leads her into the woods, where Yelena's handler shoots her.

beats.title: Captain America: Brave New World
beats.text: President Ross's security adviser, named as trained in the Red Room. She leads the attack investigation and sides with Sam.

beats.title: What If...?#14
beats.text: One of Melina's Widows in Captain Carter's world. On Melina's order she shoots at Natasha's bad knee, then Natasha stuns her.

beats.title: What If...?#14
beats.text: Another of Melina's Widows, told to straighten her back. She joins the attack on Natasha and is stunned by Widow's Bites.

shang_chi: Yes. Helen, a Widow freed from the Red Room in Black Widow (credited there only as 'Widow'), is the same character who appears in Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings. In Macau she fights an Extremis-powered man at Xialing's Golden Daggers Club, and Jon Jon shouts 'Nice one, Helen!'. Shang-Chi never says on screen that she is a Widow: the link comes from the same character and actor (Wikipedia: she 'reprises her role as a Black Widow named Helen'). No other Red Room or Black Widow character appears in Shang-Chi. Sources: https://marvelcinematicuniverse.fandom.com/wiki/Helen_(Widow) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Shang-Chi_and_the_Legend_of_the_Ten_Rings&action=raw
proposed_steps: In a Soviet school that trains girls as assassins, young Dottie shares bread with her friend Anya, then breaks Anya's neck in a sparring match.
When Peggy's team raids the school, a girl named Eva fakes tears, stabs Dugan and shoots two commandos before escaping through the vents.

Under Dreykov's chemical control, Yelena and Ingrid lead Widows to Morocco to seize the antidote from Oksana, an escaped Widow. Yelena fatally stabs Oksana, who frees her with the antidote before she dies.
Ingrid leads the Widows and Taskmaster after Natasha and Yelena in Budapest. Ingrid falls and breaks her leg, and Dreykov makes her shoot herself.
In the Red Room, Lerato, Helen and the other Widows overpower Natasha until Yelena frees them with the antidote gas.
A Widow from Finland asks what they do now, and the freed Widows, Lerato and Helen among them, fly out with Yelena and Antonia to free the others.
In 2018, Yelena and Sonya break into the home of another former Widow, Ana, and spray her with the antidote. Ana was never under Dreykov's control and now kills for money.
Five years later, Ana has a husband and daughter and welcomes Yelena back.
In Macau, a fighter named Helen takes on an Extremis-powered man at Xialing's fight club.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Yelena remembers her Red Room days, when she led her friend Anya, a fellow trainee, into the woods to be shot by her handler.
In another world, Melina's Widows, Agnesa and Ingrid among them, ambush Natasha and Captain Carter in Sokovia until Natasha stuns them with Widow's Bites.
notes: Widows and trainees in the prime world without their own file: Anya (Agent Carter#5), Eva, Oksana, Ingrid, Lerato, Helen, the Finnish Widow, Sonya, Ana, Anya (Thunderbolts*). In What If...?#14 there are also Agnesa and a variant Ingrid. Already have files: Dottie (st-dottie-underwood), Natasha (natasha-romanoff, plus What If variants by-natasha-*), Yelena (yelena-belova, plus by-zombie-yelena), Melina (melina-vostokoff, plus by-melina and by-zombie-melina), Antonia (taskmaster), Ruth Bat-Seraph (ruth-bat-seraph, Captain America: Brave New World). Ruth has her own file, so no step for her. Dottie's file lists only Agent Carter#6 and #15, but the wiki has her on screen in Agent Carter#3 to #9, #14 and #15 (with flashbacks in #5, #6 and #8). Rulings for the owner: (a) Antonia was controlled by the Red Room but never trained as a Widow. (b) The two Anyas and Eva are trainees, not graduated Widows. (c) Madame B. (Avengers: Age of Ultron) and the Agent Carter#5 headmistress are trainers, not Widows. (d) The variant Helen in What If...?#14 is unnamed and silent, so she is left out. (e) The What If...?#14 step is set in another world, so it could go in a separate 'by-' variant file if the app keeps variants apart. (f) The Thunderbolts* step is a memory, so its status is kept as Allied. Agent Carter never uses the name 'Red Room' on screen (the wiki says it is the Red Room Academy), so the steps say 'a Soviet school that trains girls as assassins'. No year is given because the wiki's 1937 date may not appear on screen. The 31 other Widows in Black Widow are uncredited extras and are not singled out. Searches of Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D., Marvel Zombies (only Yelena and Melina) and What If...?#21 (only a silent Natasha) found no other Widows. Spider-Man: Brand New Day only mentions the Red Room.
